<!-- pr-reviewer: 0aef90a5dad59d5d397b830b26684691597044b8 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (one small blocker: clippy).

Thank you @tbrasselle - this is a well-structured contribution. Red pins first, a role API that returns the existing `Alignment`, and it reuses the undoable `SetWcs` rather than adding a command.

**What looks good**
- Everything Is a Command holds: Apply queues the existing `CommandKind::SetWcs` (`wcs_pick_row.rs`); the draft is ephemeral UI state, and no world writes happen outside commands.
- Refusals come back by name from `align_roles` and the UI shows the app's own words on the disabled Apply, so there is one source for the "why".
- `crates/app/src/pick/roles.rs` has no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. Degenerate wall fits and missing datums return `Err`.
- Layering is respected (ui calls `pick::align_roles`; no component declared outside `schema.rs`). Provenance lines are present on the new modules. The decision file `docs/decisions/701-wcs-from-features.md` exists. No dependency, `build.rs`, script or `.github` changes. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #701`, and commit subjects are conventional.
- No `CHANGELOG.md` edit in the PR.

**Local results (PR head merged with upstream/main `4827fde6`; the merge was a no-op, the branch is already on current main and mergeable)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wcs_roles` | 6 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | 103 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 430 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib -- -D warnings` | FAILED, 5 errors, all in `roles.rs` |

```
error: this `if` statement can be collapsed          crates/app/src/pick/roles.rs:123:13
error: the loop variable `i` is used to index `v`    crates/app/src/pick/roles.rs:435:14
error: the loop variable `k` is only used to index `a`  crates/app/src/pick/roles.rs:452:22
error: the loop variable `k` is only used to index `a`  crates/app/src/pick/roles.rs:457:22
error: the loop variable `k` is only used to index `v`  crates/app/src/pick/roles.rs:462:22
```
I did not build the unrelated `lathe_thread_travel` test (known #686), only the touched suites.

**Requested before merge**
1. Clear the five clippy lints above (`roles.rs:123` collapse the nested `if let`/`if`; `:435`, `:452`, `:457`, `:462` use iterators, or an `#[allow(clippy::needless_range_loop)]` with a one-line reason on the small 3x3 Jacobi). The gate runs clippy with `-D warnings`.
2. `crates/app/src/pick/roles.rs` is 477 lines, over the ~400-line law as a new file. Please split along the seam you already have, e.g. move the wall fit (`fit_wall`, `perp_basis`, `jacobi_sym3`, roughly lines 300-477) into `pick/wall_fit.rs`.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Overlap with #692, for the maintainer: PR #705 (feature graph and pick API) and draft PR #709 (rewires every UI picker through one pick rule) both touch `interact.rs`, `vertex_pick.rs` and `crates/app/src/pick.rs`, as this PR does. #706 adds `wcs_pick::collecting` branches in `interact.rs` `pick_face`/`pick_edge` and its own `datum_for`/`wall_datum` resolution from `GeoSel`, which #705/#709 will probably replace with the graph's feature types. Expect textual conflicts in `interact.rs` and `pick.rs` once either lands, and the `GeoSel`-based datum code may later want to read from the new feature graph. This is a duplication question for the maintainer, not a defect here.
- `wcs_pick.rs:118,131,142` use `expect` in tests only, which is fine.
- `interact.rs` (1788 lines) and `state.rs` (4065) were already over the 400-line law; this PR adds a little to them, which is not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 5237db0611215724af0f73f9fa29bbc9d3acbb47 -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge** (one correctness blocker in the frame maths; the earlier clippy and file-size blockers are fixed).

Thank you @tbrasselle - the review fixes landed cleanly, and this is a tidy contribution.

**Earlier blockers**
- Five clippy lints in `roles.rs`: fixed, clippy is clean at this head.
- `roles.rs` over 400 lines: fixed, the wall fit now lives in `pick/wall_fit.rs` (roles 283, wall_fit 205).
- The branch is already merged with current main (it contains `upstream/main`; trial merge was a no-op), so the stale `conflicts` label is dropped.

**What looks good**
- Everything Is a Command holds: Apply queues the existing `CommandKind::SetWcs` -> `SetWcsOrigin` (undoable, undo restores the previous frame; the kittest pins round-trip it). The draft is ephemeral view state; non-finite angles are refused in the handler.
- Picks are read through `setup_align::view_pose`, the same frame #326/#738/#746 use for setup alignment, so the result composes with an aligned setup instead of fighting it. It reuses `align`'s `straight_edge`/`vertex`/`outward_normal` and `face_origin` rather than duplicating them, and the #709 pick wire (`feature_click`) carries the new draft with a one-line hook.
- Refusals are by name: too few picks, duplicate role, fewer than two axes, parallel axes (5 degree tilt rule), zero-length/curved/closed edge, flat or non-round wall, stale feature, non-finite result. No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests (the three in `wcs_pick.rs` are test-only).
- Layering is respected, no new components, provenance lines on all new modules, all files under 400 lines, decision file present, no snapshot PNG, process-file, dependency, `build.rs` or `.github` changes. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #701`.

**Local results (merged with main)**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test wcs_roles` | 6 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | 107 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (from `crates/ui`) | 461 passed, 5 ignored |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
1. `crates/app/src/pick/roles.rs:~110` (`let a = d1.dir.ok_or_else(...)`): when the FIRST axis pick is a straight edge, `datum_for` returns the raw `b - a` walk as `dir` (roles.rs ~line 218), and `a` is used unnormalised as the frame axis. The second axis is normalised by `square_to`, but the first and the derived third (`cross(a, x)`) carry the edge's length, so `Alignment.x/y/z` are not orthonormal and `quat_from_axes` (Shepperd on a scaled matrix) returns a wrong rotation, silently. Reproduced locally on a 20x20x10 block pitched 25 degrees about X: Z = the block's vertical 10 mm edge, X = its +X side face gives `y = [0, 9.06, 4.23]`, `z = [0, -4.23, 9.06]` and roll 45.56 degrees, where the same frame from the top face gives `y`, `z` unit and roll 25 degrees. For an axis-aligned part it happens to look right (identity), which is why the pins miss it. Fix: normalise `a` (refuse non-finite or zero length by name) right after reading it, and add a pin with an edge as Z (or X) on a tilted part asserting orthonormal axes and the expected euler angles. This is the Prime Directive case: a wrong WCS rotation posts shifted toolpaths with no diagnostic.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- MCP: no new command is added (it reuses `SetWcs`), so the "commands ship with an MCP tool" rule is not triggered; the MCP `set_wcs` takes an absolute origin/quaternion only. A follow-up `MCP: set WCS from feature picks` issue (`area:mcp`, P1, `source:agent`) would keep the agent surface level with the GUI - please name one in the body if you file it.
- The role row takes faces, edges, vertices and walls but not the arc/circle centres from #705/#692 (`PickKinds.centres: false` in `feature_click.rs`), so a hole-rim centre cannot be the Origin pick yet. A natural follow-up now that `feature_arc` has landed.
- `interact.rs` and `state.rs` were already over the 400-line law; this PR adds only a few lines to `state.rs`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
